items.question: Was the inventory count attended or an alternative performed, with test counts agreed to the count sheets and the final listing?
Has the inventory count cut-off been tested, with roll-forward or roll-back to the reporting date where the count was on another date?
Has inventory been tested for lower of cost and net realisable value, including slow-moving and obsolete stock?
Has the costing of inventory been agreed to supplier invoices and the costing method confirmed as consistently applied?
Have gross margin trends by product line been analysed and unusual movements explained?
Have sales returns, credit notes and discounts after period end been reviewed for cut-off?
